claims.location: source name, characteristics[biological replicate], comment[data file], factor value[TNF stimulation], factor value[GLK condition] rows 1-24
claims.value: 24 WT synovial fibroblast RAW files, three replicates of eight TNF/GLK-coded combinations
claims.evidence: The 24 WT filenames encode WT1-3, no TNF or TNF5/15/30, and GLK1h present/absent. The paper Methods and results identify WT synovial fibroblasts stimulated with hTNF for 5/15/30 min with or without 500 uM amisulpride for one hour; three biological replicates are stated. No source explicitly decodes GLK1h for the individual RAW files, so the SDRF preserves that literal code and does not assert a run-level drug assignment.

claims.location: characteristics[organism], characteristics[organism part], characteristics[cell type], characteristics[disease], characteristics[material type] rows 1-24
claims.evidence: The paper identifies WT mouse synovial fibroblasts, and the dataset record identifies Mus musculus. 'Synovium' reflects the tissue of origin named by the paper.

claims.value: not available controlled process; TiIMAC-HP beads as exact method
claims.evidence: Supplemental Methods, Phosphoproteomics samples processing and analysis, reports phosphopeptide enrichment using TiIMAC-HP beads. The process is held as the permitted reserved value because the precise phrase does not resolve to a controlled EFO/PRIDE child in the offline validator; the exact method remains in the custom field.

claims.location: comment[instrument], comment[proteomics data acquisition method], comment[cleavage agent details] (two columns), comment[reduction reagent], comment[alkylation reagent] rows 1-24
claims.value: Orbitrap Exploris 480, DIA, Lys-C and Trypsin, TCEP, chloroacetamide
claims.evidence: The phosphoproteomics section on supplement pages 2-3 names the instrument and DIA, PAC digestion with LysC and Trypsin, and TCEP and CAA in lysis buffer. The separate target-identification SP3/DDA method on supplement page 1 does not apply to these Phos500ug files.
Supplemental Methods reports phosphorylation of serine, threonine and tyrosine as variable modifications in directDIA analysis.

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance], comment[fragment mass tolerance] rows 1-24
claims.evidence: No exact search tolerances are given in the accessible supplemental methods.

limitations: This SDRF covers only the 24 paper-described WT runs; the 12 Tg files require a separately verified time-course map and will be handled in a separate SDRF.
The GLK1h filename token has not been decoded by an accession-specific sample key. It remains a literal experimental-condition code in this SDRF pending submitter confirmation.

The installed validator rejects the ontology-encoded DIA acquisition value under the dia-acquisition template, so the plain controlled label Data-independent acquisition is used, matching an established repository precedent.

The ontology-backed enrichment-process field uses not available because the paper-supported phrase does not resolve in the offline EFO/PRIDE list; TiIMAC-HP beads are retained in the custom enrichment-method field.
A deterministic postprocessing script adds the second cleavage agent column after the SDRF builder runs.
